title: GET /index.json route for the viewer ID lookup
description: `GET /index.json` returns the server-side ID index as `application/json; charset=utf-8` with `cache-control: no-store`. The handler reads `state.indexJson` (snapshotted per rewalk from `renderModelToPage().indexJson` so bytes match Content-Length) and never touches disk; before the first walk it 503s with `view server initialising`. The route is release-noted (PR 1 relative-script policy, wespa reverse-proxy allow-list adds it before the version pin bump) and is the fourth release-noted viewer route after `./page-init.js` (AC-205-1).
